sentences.text: This is an application, filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, seeking condonation of delay of 447 days, which has caused in filing the Appeal.

Learned AGP waives service of notice of Rule for respondent No.2.
3.

Learned advocate for the applicant has submitted that applicant was infected with Corona Virus,
therefore, applicant could not approach any advocate.
It is further submitted that due to pandemic situation of Covid-19, the applicant was not able to pay attention to his business.
Resultantly, he was suffering from severe financial crisis.
It is further submitted that there is no NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/47/2024 ORDER DATED: 04/09/2025 undefined intentional delay on the part of the applicant and therefore, delay may be condoned.

4. Considering the submissions of learned advocate for the applicant and considering the averments made in the application, sufficient cause is made out to condone the delay submit to deposit a cost of Rs.5,000/- before the Gujarat High Court Advocates' Library, Ahmedabad within 10 days from the date of this order.
